Upstream https://github.com/yetone/magpie-releases/releases/tag/v0.1.4746

Downstream build `0f6f6e6e48bac3ef41350b6948d9d7ef88827200`. Windows desktop executable and macOS DMG / update ZIP.

## Features

- Added the ability to untick a key across all models in a provider's gateway keys.

### Install

Download from [usemagpie.ai](https://usemagpie.ai), or `curl -fsSL https://usemagpie.ai/install.sh | sh`. An installed magpie updates itself.

- **macOS (Apple Silicon):** `magpie-darwin-arm64.dmg`
- **macOS (Intel):** `magpie-darwin-amd64.dmg`
- **Windows:** `magpie-windows-amd64.exe` (ARM: `magpie-windows-arm64.exe`)
- **Linux:** `magpie-linux-amd64` / `magpie-linux-arm64` (needs GTK 3 and WebKitGTK 4.1)
- **Terminal only:** `magpie-cli-<os>-<arch>`

Thanks to justforlxz, whose reports and code went into this release. Everyone who helped: [contributors](https://usemagpie.ai/docs/contributors).
